parties.respondent: Bhagwantpal Singh Alias Bhagwant Singh (Deceased) Through Lrs.

summary: Possession dispute; land donation for veterinary hospital; limitation under Article 65 of Limitation Act; ownership burden under Evidence Act s.110; adverse possession pleaded without evidence or animus possidendi; revenue records as proof of ownership; suit barred by time given continuous possession since 1958; High Court erred in ignoring established possession; impugned judgment set aside; suit reinstated; dismissal confirmed.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; Appellate Court's dismissal of suit restored; respondents' suit dismissed.
